newsitem.title: USA: America West to lower air fares.
newsitem.headline: America West to lower air fares.

text.p: America West said on Friday it plans to lower air fares.
For the next two weeks, America West said it is offering seven day advance purchase fares ranging from $84 to $179 each way based on destination and date of travel.
Fares during peak travel dates are higher, the company said.
Tickets must be purchased within 72 hours of making reservations and no later than Jan. 17, the company said.
Travel may commence as early as Jan. 10, 1997 and must be completed by May 18, the company said.
